sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 94% of earnings against free cash flow of 117% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 55 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded 2.3% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 1 hard red flags and 2 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 65/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.

paragraphs: Margin mean-reversion: operating margin of 16.0% sits +1.0pp versus its five-year median of 15.0%; a return to the median would close a 1.0 percentage-point margin gap.
